name: memreduct-mcp
description: Free RAM on Windows with your own Mem Reduct before memory-hungry jobs, without admin prompts.
long_description: Presses the clean memory hotkey of the Mem Reduct already running in your tray, waits until Mem Reduct records the clean, and reports available RAM before and after. Needs [Mem Reduct](https://github.com/henrypp/memreduct) running with its **Clean memory** hotkey enabled; `memreduct_setup_check` says what to fix. Cleaning helps right before a job that would not fit in RAM; it does not make a PC faster in general.

tools.name: memory_status
tools.description: Report total, available and committed RAM and the processes using the most memory.

tools.name: clean_memory
tools.description: Free RAM with Mem Reduct and return available RAM before and after.

tools.name: memreduct_setup_check
tools.description: Check that Mem Reduct is installed, running and has its clean hotkey enabled.
